candidate_sentence_map.S1: Infortar reported a strong operating year in 2025, with revenue rising to EUR 1.837 billion from EUR 1.372 billion and EBITDA increasing to EUR 227.9 million from EUR 145.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The EBITDA margin improved to 12.4% from 10.6%.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Gross profit increased to EUR 239.8 million from EUR 128.6 million, while operating profit rose to EUR 109.0 million from EUR 77.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: However, net profit declined substantially to EUR 69.9 million from EUR 193.7 million, and profit attributable to the parent fell to EUR 70.6 million from EUR 191.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Earnings per share decreased to EUR 3.43 from EUR 9.36.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Management attributes the lower net profit mainly to one-off effects from the initial consolidation of Tallink in 2024, including a EUR 93.7 million bargain-purchase gain; the 2025 results included no comparable gain.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The main driver of revenue and EBITDA growth was Tallink Grupp, which was consolidated for the full twelve months in 2025 compared with only five months in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Maritime transport revenue increased to EUR 761.7 million from EUR 316.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Tallink carried 5.53 million passengers, down 0.9% year on year, while cargo units declined 19.2% and passenger vehicles 2.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Vessel chartering generated EUR 54.9 million and helped reduce seasonal fluctuations.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The energy segment remained the largest revenue contributor, with external revenue of EUR 980.2 million compared with EUR 966.2 million, while Elenger’s EBITDA improved by approximately EUR 12 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Energy deliveries remained stable at 18 TWh despite a 9% decline in regional gas consumption and continued price volatility.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Growth also reflected the full-year inclusion of Elenger Polska and the contribution of agricultural businesses.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Infortar acquired 96.6% of Estonia Farmid in July, adding dairy and farming operations that contributed EUR 11.2 million of revenue and EUR 6.4 million of profit attributable to owners during the reporting period.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: It also acquired Oisu Biogaas in November and continued expanding biomethane, solar generation, and energy-storage activities.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Tallink invested EUR 33 million in vessel maintenance and refurbishment, while Group investment in property, plant, equipment, real estate, and intangible assets totaled approximately EUR 80.1 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash increased to EUR 219.8 million from EUR 167.6 million, and operating cash flow rose to EUR 384.0 million from EUR 89.3 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Interest-bearing liabilities declined to EUR 1.071 billion from EUR 1.223 billion, while net debt fell to EUR 851.6 million from EUR 1.056 billion; net debt to EBITDA improved to 3.7 from 4.0.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Total equity increased to EUR 1.175 billion and the equity ratio improved to 45% from 43%.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Infortar paid approximately EUR 62 million in dividends for 2024 and proposed a 2025 dividend of EUR 3.02 per share.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K6, K7, K8 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K4 is PRESENT via S12 (18 TWh LNG delivery). K5 is MISSING - no mention of Rimi logistics centre, Depo DIY retail space, or Rail Baltica contract. The summary captures most HIGH-importance material (7/8), but the omission of a specific major infrastructure/real-estate project (K5) constitutes a material gap, placing the overall coverage at 'Generally yes'.
